name: MoreFoWorld
notes: Experimental release v1.13.4-folia.1 adds `createWorld(WorldCreator)` and is installed on Folia 1.21.11 build 14. MoreFoWorld loaded before CMI and added lobby; its API enabled live Multiverse create/import/load smokes on empty disposable worlds. Create exceeded Folia's 5-second global-region watchdog reporting threshold; import/load completed after about 37 seconds. Test world data is in rollback. Player RTP, teleports, portals, unload, and cross-region world lifecycle remain unverified. The implementation uses server internals and is not a production-safe general world lifecycle API.
